summary.text: Elizabeth McCrank is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Calvin Callahan (R).
She also ran against Callahan in 2024.

paragraphs.text: McCrank won the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 35 on August 13, 2024, and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Callahan, 67.7 percent to 32.2 percent.
She advanced from the Democratic primary again on August 11, 2026.
